lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Cu4Sb2O12 (reduced formula LiCu2SbO6) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cu and Sb centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Li adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Cu and Sb octahedra, and both corner- and edge-sharing occur between Cu and Li octahedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
